children: Marygold Companies, through subsidiaries Gourmet Foods and Printstock, entered a definitive agreement to sell substantially all Printstock assets to TAG Investments for NZ$2.45 million (about US$1.4 million). The price will be adjusted at closing based on a joint stock-take, with TAG to place a 10% deposit once conditions are met. Due diligence and financing conditions are due within 20 working days, landlord consent within 10 working days thereafter, and closing is expected on Nov 20, 2026. The deal includes a five-year restraint of trade in New Zealand for Printstock and specified covenantors.

: One-time transaction; five-year non-compete in New Zealand
: Divest non-core Printstock operations and streamline portfolio
